title: Excellent informative private tour
text: What an incredible experience. I arranged a great value private tour with Marco who was such a pleasure to liase with prior to our tour. On meeting him, he's even more lovely. Incredibly warm, helpful and generous with his knowledge of Seville. Pablo took us out on our tour and he was equally delightful. Such an interesting and knowledgeable guy. We toured Seville at a comfortable pace and he always checked to ensure we weren't far behind him. We felt very safe with Pablo as our guide. Earlier on in the year I'd joined an overcrowded bike  tour in Copenhagen which was awful and felt terrifying
author: TJMcGarry

title: The best way to see Seville!
text: I highly recommend this tour! Our guide, Antonio, gave us an expert, hilarious, and fascinating overview of Seville. This was such a fun way to see the city! He and Marcos were extremely kind and charming, and they gave wonderful restaurant recommendations as well. If you're considering a tour with Hop On Bike Tours - do it!
author: 435kathrynp

title: To do absolutely!
text: We booked a tour with a guide in French for our group of 8 people. Very good communication with Marcos for the reservation. The bikes are of good quality and our guide Yéyé very friendly! We’ve toured Seville and it’s a great way to start your stay in Seville to discover all the neighborhoods of the city. We went through some unusual little corners and our guide gave us many detailed and unusual explanations. Count 3 hours. Free bottle of water and reward glass at the end! I highly recommend!
author: Nath4960

title: Great experience
text: Comfortable bike, friendly service, lots of local information and useful advice made such a difference. I had wonderful time. Seville is best seen on bike!
author: chiki604

title: I remind the service and the meeting very warmly!
text:
I rent a bike for a day and visited all distanced places in Sevilla during 7 hours. It was enough time for visiting, having a little cofee and take a look of the city from different perspectives.
Additional value : very nice conversation with the nice owner !!! Just a fine spanish language course ...
On the last day I leaved my luggage here for some hours as my departure was in the evening - the place is next to the bus station Plaza de Armas ( It is very hard to find free locker in the bus station, thera are no lockers on the airport in Sevila), so this service is very valuable.
author: carmen649

title: Excellent
text: The bike very comfortable and good condition , the treatment in the pick up and drop of excellent bike, gave us very very good recommendations, It is worth renting a bike to visit quietly Seville and enjoy all that the city has...
author: germangJ5455RZ

title: Very good!
text:
Marco was very pleasant and even when the chain failed on one of our city bikes, the whole bike immediately changed. In the city, cycling is easily possible and all Sevilleans by car or scooter will pick you up.

 Thank you again.
author: EnzoFerrari1993

title: Recommended bike rental 100%
text: Recommended 100%.Super friendly and friendly it is nice to meet people like this when you are a few days on vacation, the bikes are in perfect condition and very well maintained.
author: Moni3112P

title: Experience more than advisable
text:
We rented bikes with them as a family, the bikes very well and the shop very central, we had a great time....
We will repeat again

author: PabloCramazou

title: Bike rental for the day
text: We rented bikes in the morning and returned them in the afternoon. The bikes were great and in excellent condition. The owner of the bike rental was very nice, and showed us the best places to eat tapas in Seville. We also biked in the city park which was wonderful too. Thank you for this great experience!
author: Adel_best1
